First queued heal is immediate, remaining receipts drain every .12seconds, ignoring ally-heal refusal; death/withdraw cancels owned queue. All eligible ground enemies in the attack range are hit independently, not capped by block count. S1s use two separately mitigated full-strength hits, once-per-attack SP.

runtimeMapping.Highmore: Source E1/E2 selected injury heal applies to all element gauges except active burst locks. Exact rogue_mizuki certified map tag alone grants selected ASPD/block bonus.
